note: units of 10 mA; positive is charging, negative is discharging
packed: bits 15-9 year since 2000, bits 8-5 month, bits 4-0 day
bit n set: cell n+1 is balancing
bit n set: cell n+17 is balancing
byte 20; flags are b8 and b9 because the loader reads 8-bit flags from the upper half of the word at the byte offset
raw is tenths of a kelvin; rows beyond the sensor count the pack reports are dropped
command 0x04, millivolts; rows beyond the cell count the pack reports are dropped
